title: OneDrive is creating a bunch of 'conflict' files
description: I edited the same document from two devices, and now I'm seeing files with a '-conflict' suffix in every folder.

worklogs.description: Reviewed the version history of the conflicting files and selected the most up-to-date version.
Manually cleaned up the conflict files and gave the user a workflow recommendation.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: I paused OneDrive on one of the devices and the conflicts were cleared up. Instead of editing simultaneously from two devices, I'd suggest signing out from one of them.

resolutionNote: Conflict files were cleaned up by keeping the most up-to-date version. The user was advised to use 'Files On-Demand'.
